title: Product Launch for Healgen Combo 3 in 1 Test Kits
targetAudience: Customers of pharmacies, e-commerce platforms, and retail stores
overview: Designed launch assets for Healgen's Combo 3-in-1 Test Kits, creating realistic product visuals before the final packaging was manufactured.
challenge: Marketing assets were required before the final packaging existed. By digitally compositing the approved artwork onto prototype photos, I produced realistic product imagery that was ready for launch across all sales channels.
impact: The final assets enabled the marketing team to launch the product on schedule despite production constraints. The visuals were used across the company's website, Shopee, Lazada, pharmacy displays, and retail stores, providing customers with a polished and consistent brand experience from online discovery to in-store purchase.
takeaways: This project demonstrates my ability to deliver cohesive launch assets across multiple touchpoints while working within a regulated industry. It strengthened my understanding of HSA labelling requirements and the importance of integrating regulatory information without compromising visual clarity or brand consistency.

title: Logo Design and Loader Design for  Schemes SG
overview: SchemesSG is an AI-powered chatbot to connect users to the right social assistance schemes.
challenge: The challenge was to design a visual identity that balanced warmth and professionalism, ensuring the platform felt welcoming to users while remaining clear and recognisable across digital touchpoints.
takeaways: Designing for SchemesSG highlighted the responsibility designers have in creating inclusive experiences. Exploring WCAG guidelines helped me better understand how thoughtful decisions around colour, contrast, and simplicity can make a visual identity more accessible without compromising its character.

title: Training Video for Drug Test Collectors - ClarityScreening
overview: This training video is a revamp of existing content designed for drug test collectors worldwide. It demonstrates the proper procedures for collecting urine samples, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. It serves as an essential resource for training new collectors and reinforcing best practices among experienced professionals.
challenge: The original video was outdated and lacked engagement, standing at 20 minutes long. The challenge was to create a more concise and visually focused video that effectively communicates the necessary information while keeping the audience engaged throughout. I worked with limited resources, without a proper phone tripod or professional lighting, and had to rely on creative solutions to achieve a polished final product.
takeaways: This project reinforced the importance of clear and concise storytelling in informative and training content. Considering the natual attention span of humans, it is critical to reduce the timing of the training video. The video is created for drug test collectors worldwide, and English may not be their first language. taught me how to work with limited resources and still produce a high-quality video. It also reinforced the importance of clear communication and concise storytelling in educational content, as well as the value of collaboration and adaptability in the production process.

title: Website Redesign for recruitment agency - Ambition Asia
targetAudience: Jobseekers, particularly first encounters with the website
overview: UX redesign of Ambition Singapore's recruitment site for first-time jobseekers, working solo within a fixed brand constraint.
challenge: No filters. Inconsistent labels. A Salary Guide buried deeper than any competitor's. First-timers were getting lost before they got started.

title: Campaign: Shared Services 2024 - Ambition Asia
overview: Ambition Asia, the APAC arm of an Australian recruitment company, wants to enhance their online presence and improve the user experience for job seekers.
challenge: Improve the discoverability of relevant job opportunities through a more intuitive search experience, while also maintaining the brand identity.

title: Printed Corporate Assets for recruitment firm - Ambition Asia
targetAudience: Employees and clients of Ambition Asia
overview: Ambition needs printed corporate assets to reinforce their brand identity for internal and external communications. The assets have to be visually appealing and consistent with the brand's visual identity.
challenge: The main challenge was maintaining accuracy and visual consistency across multiple asset types while adapting each format to different layout requirements.
impact: The final printed assets were successfully produced and used across client events and internal gifting initiatives, extending Ambition's brand identity beyond digital channels while delivering a consistent and professional brand experience.

title: Visual Identity for Pet Needs Store - Blove Pet Needs
overview: K Pet Needs, a local pet supply store, needed a visual identity as a tribute to their late pets, Chocoby and Hunniby.
challenge: Two beloved Frenchies passed away tragically from an accident. The visual identity needed to be carefully crafted to honor their memory while establishing a strong brand presence in the market.
impact: The visual identity successfully honored the memory of the pets while establishing a strong brand presence in the market.
takeaways: The brand continued to operate under the visual identity I designed for five years until it closed in 2026, which showed me how much the identity resonated with the owners and reflected the story they wanted to preserve. This project taught me that great branding is about more than aesthetics—it is about creating meaningful, lasting connections through thoughtful design. Although the business has since closed, its legacy lives on through its Instagram archive, preserving the brand and the memories behind it.

title: Corporate Introduction Video for recruitment firm - Ambition Asia
overview: Ambition Asia needed a video that introduces the company's culture and values to recruitment consultants in a positive way.
challenge: The snippets were filmed by the employees and quality varied. The challenge was to create a cohesive and engaging video that effectively communicates the company's culture and values while maintaining a professional and polished look.
takeaways: The video was used in Ambition's Work for Us page to attract potential recruitment consultants till today.
